ana: Heads-up — we detected late ingest for user-agg-hours covering 2025-03-01..2025-03-03. Planning a recompute/backfill later today. Need quick decisions on routing/quota handling and what we surface in Console UX. TL;DR: if the backfill steals capacity we risk P95 API latency regressions for hosted customers. Thoughts?

jamal: I think we should run the recompute on a priority lane with soft throttles. Reserve ~20% of capacity for live traffic and let backfills use spare. We can enforce via router policy tag `backfill=true` + quota group that has lower priority.

sasha: Agree on reserve. Two follow-ups: 1) Can we auto-fallback requests to cached summaries / cheaper model variant during the window? 2) Console should show a conspicuous banner and expected SLO impact estimate so support teams don't get surprised.

marta: UI idea — a Recompute panel that lists active backfills, job id, progress %, ETA, and a pause/resume button. Also show a toggle to opt this run into "low impact" mode (stronger concurrency cap). Would be a small Console feature but huge for ops.

jamal: Implementation note: router can respect a `quota_class=backfill` header coming from the orchestrator. Then token-bucket rules treat it as best-effort. We'll need a quick config change in routing rules and a default low refill rate for that class.

deploy-bot: backfill-operator started job backfill-2025-03-05-001 for user-agg-hours. link: https://console/redwood/backfills/backfill-2025-03-05-001 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ana: (typo) ana: Command I used for a dry-run/controlled run — sets concurrency and low priority:```rbackfill run --job user-agg-hours --range 2025-03-01:2025-03-03 \
  --job-id backfill-2025-03-05-001 \
  --max-concurrency 30 \
  --priority low \
  --quota-class backfill
```This will let routing pick it up as best-effort.

sasha: Can we also tag telemetry events from the recompute so dashboards can filter them? Need `recompute:true` on emitted metrics and traces. That will let us create a Console filter to hide or show backfill-influenced metrics.

ana: ana: Good call. We'll add the metric tag and a dashboard filter. Also want an SLO blurb for status page: e.g., "We are running a scheduled recompute that may increase P95 latency by up to X ms for up to Y hours; production traffic is prioritized." Sasha, can you draft?

sasha: Yep, I'll draft the status blurb and a short KB entry for support. Leaving room for numbers after jamal's capacity sim.

jamal: I'll run a quick capacity sim with the proposed 20% reserve and post numbers in this thread by EOD. If numbers look bad we can drop concurrency or schedule to off-peak.

marta: I'll wire up a minimal UX change — banner + job panel + pause/resume endpoint. Will PR with a mock and route to QA.

ana: ana: Summary / action items: @jamal update router policy + run sim, @marta console panel + banner + pause endpoint, @sasha draft SLO/status blurb and KB, I'll coordinate backfill run and ensure `recompute:true` metric tags. Start time target: 2025-03-05 22:00 UTC. :thumbsup: 

sasha: ack.

jamal: ack, starting sim now.

deploy-bot: backfill-operator updated job backfill-2025-03-05-001 state -> queued
